_engine_note: engine: kokoro (Kokoro-82M on the CPU, the default) or qwen (Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign through audio.cpp on the GPU, optional, uses 'voice'). Switch in the app's Settings tab; the choice is saved here.
_voice_note: Qwen3-TTS only: a voice name from voice/designs/round1_samples.json or round2_samples.json: whisper child eerie nervous old rasp innocent synthetic low chitter whisper_pitchup rasp_buzz | low_buzz low_shift low_insect low_dramatic low_fly_dramatic chitin_ring.
_ui_note: false (default): the voice stays off until switched on in Settings or the Mind tab. true: the page switches it on by itself when this server is running.
_stt_note: cpu (default, int8, 2 threads) or auto (CUDA when the card in FLY_VOICE_GPU has stt_min_free_mb free; needs the CUDA 12 cuBLAS and cuDNN 9 DLLs that faster-whisper's CTranslate2 loads).
